message: ADD COLUMN fts_tokens GENERATED ALWAYS AS ... STORED on page_section rewrites every row and locks the table for the duration.
help: STORED generated columns store the computed value physically. Postgres must evaluate the generation expression for every existing row and write the result, requiring a full table rewrite under AccessExclusiveLock. On large tables this blocks reads and writes for minutes. The expand-contract pattern: ADD COLUMN nullable, backfill in batches with explicit UPDATEs, optionally promote to GENERATED later. Postgres 18+ VIRTUAL generated columns are computed on read and don't trigger a rewrite (but require a much newer Postgres version).

lock_impact.note: safe path: add a nullable column and backfill in batches

message: CREATE INDEX fts_search_index without CONCURRENTLY blocks writes on page_section for the duration of the build.
help: Non-concurrent CREATE INDEX takes AccessExclusiveLock for the full build duration. On a populated table this blocks all writes (UPDATE/INSERT/DELETE) until the index is built — minutes on a large table. CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY uses a slower but non-blocking build path. It cannot run inside a transaction, so it must be its own migration statement.
suggested_fix: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY fts_search_index ON page_section (<columns>);

lock_impact.note: safe path: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY — ShareUpdateExclusive, blocks neither
